**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Hymns to the Perfect Scripture of the Way and its Virtue*

by [蔣融庵](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%94%A3%E8%9E%8D%E5%BA%B5) (Jiǎng Róng'ān) — Míng Daoist author

A Míng **verse-response** to the *Dào dé jīng* — paralleling Sòng Luán's [KR5c0377](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0377). Preserved as **DZ 978** / CT 978 (*Dòngshén bù, Zàn sòng lèi* 洞神部讚頌類).

**Dating.** Early Míng, by 1445. Dynasty: 明.
